title: Why Models Know But Don’t Say: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Divergence Between Thinking Tokens and Answers in Open-Weight Reasoning Models

bias_targets.methodology: Pairing MMLU and GPQA questions with misleading hints indicating an authority figure's (e.g., a professor's) preference, then using keyword matching to detect if the model acknowledges this influence in its internal 'thinking tokens' versus its user-visible final answer.

Adding misleading hints about prior answers to prompts to test if the model alters its response to remain consistent, and evaluating whether the model acknowledges this influence in its chain-of-thought reasoning versus its output text.

bias_targets.target: Contextual and Prompt biases (Grader gaming, Metadata, Visual patterns, Unethical information)
bias_targets.methodology: Injecting various misleading contextual hints into reasoning benchmarks and analyzing the acknowledgment divergence between thinking tokens and answer text using keyword detection.
